Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account

Class RegisterAccountUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account.RegisterAccountUseCase
@Service public class RegisterAccountUseCase extends Object
Use case that registers an account. The account starts disabled and unverified; a signed verification token is e-mailed to the address. The answer is always the same and the password is always hashed, so neither the answer nor its timing reveals whether the address or the username is taken. What the address receives differs only where its owner learns nothing new:
  • a registered address gets a neutral "already registered" message: its owner already knows it has an account;
  • a new address with a taken username gets the usual verification message, whose token names no account, so following it fails exactly like an expired link. The username is never confirmed to whoever controls the address, so the endpoint cannot be used to find out which usernames exist.
The account is saved and the message sent in one transaction: if the mail cannot be sent, nothing is registered.
